Chapter 1

This is an original OpenStory Studio test fixture.

Lira Vale carried a palm-sized Glass Shard wrapped in blue cloth. The Glass Shard
belonged to Lira, a keepsake left by her mother.

When Lira whispered the old word Aster, the Glass Shard answered with a cold blue
light. Ashen saw the light and warned her that the wardens would notice.

CHAPTER II

At late afternoon, Lira and Ashen reached the North Gate. The North Gate stood above a
reed-choked causeway and was bound by the oldest wards in the city.

The lead guard stepped forward and asked their purpose. Lira raised the Glass Shard in
her palm. Its cold blue pulse crossed the glass-etched seals, and the North Gate opened.
